title: The Worst Thing You Could Do When Picking up Kids
description:
On December 31st, 2022, an officer noticed a vehicle going at a very high speed and switching lanes erratically. He switched on his emergency lights but the driver didn’t seem to care and kept driving. After some time, she stopped her vehicle near an intersection. Here’s what happened next. The officer had already noticed her bloodshot eye and knew that she was operating under some kind of influence. The female landed herself in trouble, when she said she was blind. She was also carrying an expired insurance card which was only going to add to her problems. The officer will now conduct a series of sobriety tests, which will give him an idea of how intoxicated the female is. The officer knew at this point that the female was heavily intoxicated, because she wasn’t able to follow his instructions clearly. The female soon started regretting her actions after being handcuffed. Soon, the officer checked on the female's friend to understand if she was intoxicated. While on their way to the jail, the female kept crying for her son. The officer let the female contact her mom. While talking to her, she broke down and started crying. The female was charged with aggravated driving under the influence, failure to maintain traffic lane, failure to present DL, speeding and mandatory financial responsibility.

Police Insider provides unbiased and authentic footage of incidents captured on body cams. We believe this footage can be used as an educational guide for viewers. 

We only provide unique and original content that hasn’t been covered before on YouTube.

The raw footage for the videos on this channel have been obtained directly from the respective Police Departments. We as a media company have the right to use it commercially. Most incidents may require a fee associated with the request and take several days to process.

The channel is not affiliated with any law enforcement agency.

Our channel is compliant with YouTube's Fair Use Policy as we create a storyline and cut down several hours of long footage to a few minutes to bring out the most entertaining and educational parts, just like other channels such as Code Blue Cam, Real World Police, Active Police Cam, Blue Watch and Bodycam FIles.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
